Name: Victy's Seasonal Outfits
Author: Yumi0224
Description:
Mod content:
I have created more seasonal, holiday, and other costumes for the original character portrait of Stardew Valley by Korean author Vicky, designed to be used in conjunction with Poltergeister's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] mod.Includes all seasons, festivals, beaches, and special costumes of the original Stardew Valley characters.

Installation:
This mod only contains PNG images and does not include code. You need to download Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics first, and then replace the Portraits folder with this mod.

Current issue:
The option 'HarveyFacialHair' is not available because I did not draw his beard.

Author's words:
I have been drawing continuously for almost two months and finally completed it - I am very happy for everyone's encouragement and support on Xiaohongshu during this period! I hope everyone has fun!I have done some simple tests on the Mod, but there are too many images, so I haven't fully tested it. So if you encounter any problems during gameplay, please leave me a message! Or send a private message to my Xiaohongshu account (Windy Cloud Sleepless)!

I once naively thought that without directly modifying or using portrait files in Slightly Cuter Aesthetics, I could avoid applying for permission. Thank you to AirynS for promptly pointing out my mistake, making me realize it, and allowing me to use his design as a reference regardless of past grievances.
During the period when I hid the mod, I made efforts to contact artists who made portraits, and luckily obtained permission from artists such as Alvadea, Jaksha, Ailins, IronZelly, HopeWasHere, etc. I am also very grateful for the help provided by Fifadog and Alvadea in this process.
For those outfits that I have not yet obtained permission for, I have redesigned and modified my images, using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2679113]Poltergeister[/url] sprites as outline.


Thanks:

My friends: Jiang Zao and Zao Qi Da Wang (they don't have accounts), helped me draw some images, which reduced my workload a bit.

模组内容：
为韩网作者Victy绘制的星露谷原版人物肖像绘制了更多季节、节日等其他服装，旨在与Poltergeister的 Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic 模组配合使用。
包含星露谷原版角色的所有季节、节日、沙滩和特殊服装。

使用方式：
本模组仅包含png图片，不包含代码，需要先下载 Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic，然后用本模组替换其中的Portraits文件夹。

目前的问题：
“哈维的胡子”这一选项是不可用的，因为我没有绘制他的胡子。

作者的话：
陆陆续续画了快两个月，终于完成啦——很高兴这段时间大家在小红书上对我的鼓励和支持！希望大家玩得开心！
我对Mod做了一些简单的测试，但是图片内容有点多，所以没有完全测试，所以如果在游玩过程中遇到问题，请给我留言！或者私信我的小红书账号（风动云不眠）！

我曾经愚昧无知地以为，自己没有直接修改或者使用Slightly Cuter Aesthetic 中的肖像文件，就可以无需申请许可。感谢AirynS及时指出了我的错误，让我醒悟过来，还不计前嫌地许可我使用他的设计作为参考。
在我把mod隐藏了的这段时间里，我努力联系了制作肖像的艺术家们，很幸运地获得了Alvadea, Jaksha, Ailins, IronZelly, HopeWasHere等艺术家的许可，也非常感谢[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/186676-fifadog/]Fifadog[/url]和Alvadea在这一过程中给我提供的帮助。
对于那些我暂时没有获得许可的设计，我在贴合行走图的基础上，重新设计、修改了我的图像。
